t928231ca2: ISO/IEC 27001 is the international standard that sets the requirements for information security management systems. Its Annex A, in the 2022 version, lists 93 controls organized into four themes: organizational, people, physical and technological. A company is not required to apply all of them. It assesses its risks and chooses how to treat them — and the Statement of Applicability, known by its acronym SoA, records those choices.
